summary.text: Bonnie Watson Coleman represents New Jersey's 12th Congressional District and is serving her sixth term in the U.S. House; she is the first Black woman to represent New Jersey in Congress.

paragraphs.text: She serves on the House Appropriations and Budget Committees.
Before Congress she served eight consecutive terms in the New Jersey General Assembly, where she became the first Black woman Majority Leader, and chaired the New Jersey Democratic State Committee.
She is the daughter of state legislator John S. Watson.
